summary: In our project, we designed a game and adapted it to computer format. The player starts as an astronaut. Due to an incident, they become separated from the rest of the team and get lost. The breath filtration is broken on their suit therefore the suit cannot filter their breath , so they have to be quick. They find remnants of past missions on Mars, learn their history, and extract parts from them. They try to build a simple radio from all the pieces. If they build the radio in time, they can call for help, but they die from lack of oxygen while the rest of the crew are trying to reach them. If they fail to build the radio in time, they die there.
details: Our project is served in an game form. It helps to teach the player about the paths humans left in Mars by making them a part of the story.
